text:
eric: Quick check — we should lock a 60m retrospective for the 3/8 model-serving OOM. Who needs to be there and who can facilitate?

alice: I can take notes and own the action-item tracker. prefer Thu morning but flexible. :white_check_mark:

ben: Thu works for me. If Wed, I need to push to after 3pm.

carol: SRE should be present for rollout/tuning context — @dena can you join? also want a short segment on telemetry gaps.

dena: I can make Thu 10–11am PST. happy to walk through the ramp/rollback timeline.

eric: Nice. Plan then: Thu 10–11am PST. Sophie, can you facilitate? you did a great job last time.

sophie: I can facilitate. Agenda proposal below — please shout if missing anything. :loud_sound:

```
Agenda (60m)
- 5m quick context & timeline (owner: eric)
- 10m what happened (timeline + root triggers) (owner: dena)
- 15m discussion: what went well / what didn't (blameless) (owner: group)
- 15m action items + owners (owner: alice)
- 10m follow-ups: monitoring, runbooks, rollout policy changes (owners: eng + SRE)
```

ben: +1 to adding a quick check on model-quant/packing thresholds (we hit OOMs at x tokens).

carol: Also request we allocate 1–2 mins to confirm stakeholders for each action (product, infra, legal if needed).

alice: I'll spin up the action tracker doc after we confirm time. linking postmortem draft for pre-read: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/3-8-model-oom-draft (please add comments)

eric: can everyone add one pre-read note by Wed EOD so Sophie can synth the key points?

dena: I'll attach the kernel logs and perf graph before EOD Wed.

devops-bot: Calendar event created: "3/8 model-serving retrospective" Thu 10:00–11:00 PST — invitees: eric, alice, ben, carol, dena, sophie — link: https://calendar.redwood/events/1767200110

ben: tiny request — can we record the session and post the recording to the postmortem doc?

sophie: yes — recording enabled. I'll capture owners inline during the call and assign follow-ups in the doc.

alice: notes template I'll use: ACTION | OWNER | ETA | STATUS. Will post tracker and ping #product and #support for any cross-team owners after the meeting.

carol: thanks all. if anyone can't make Thu 10, speak now so we can reschedule.

eric: Great — looks set. See you Thu. :calendar:
root_message: eric: Quick check — we should lock a 60m retrospective for the 3/8 model-serving OOM. Who needs to be there and who can facilitate?
